## Workflow B: follow-up

A scheduled GitHub Actions workflow calls **Follow-up webhook** with the `X-Scheduler-Token` header (every 6 hours for the demo). The run claims up to 20 leads with status `new` older than 24 hours (with an email, not spam), sends each a polite follow-up in their language, and records the results: sent leads stay `followed_up`, failed ones go back to `new` (at most 3 tries).

**Sender set?** With `LEADS_EMAIL_FROM` empty (the public demo) it claims nothing, sends nothing and answers `skipped: "no_sender"`.

**Every hour (local only)** is disabled. Enable it only on an always-on n8n (local Docker), never together with an outside scheduler.
